name: Picasa
summary: Google's free photo organizer and viewer, retired in March 2016 and offline since 2018. It scanned folders into a library with tags, faces and albums, offered simple non-destructive fixes and slideshows. Still widely searched by people who want a simple, free, local photo viewer.
where_schnellbild_wins: Maintained and runs natively on Apple silicon
Modern formats: HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL
No library scan, opens folders directly
Search with regex, dual pane, undo
